assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
CPT 93247 represents long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The monitoring was medically necessary to document intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea associated with the patient's underlying cardiovascular diagnoses
